rationale: The agent loaded the skill but did not treat strict schemas as a core requirement. Rewriting the frontmatter description to foreground additionalProperties:false primes the agent to enforce strict schemas before it reads the body instructions.
expected_effect: Agent will treat additionalProperties:false as a first-class, non-negotiable requirement and include it in all tool input schemas, resolving the strict-schema failure.
regression_risk: Low. The description change preserves mention of discoverable tools and validated inputs; priming effect may be weaker than a body instruction but does not conflict with any passing behavior.
